snippet.title: Classic Zelda Possessed by Silent Hill? | Unsound Love - New DEMO!
snippet.description:
Unsound Love - Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315700/Unsound_Love/

It’s a psychological open-world horror game that plays similarly to a Zelda game, filled with puzzles, secrets, and exploration. Scattered throughout the world are various dungeons waiting to be discovered, each featuring sequences reminiscent of Silent Hill or Little Nightmares.
